_meta.source: Scion_Origin_(Revised_Download).pdf p. 113 (Character Advancement); Scion_Hero_(Final_Download).pdf p. 185 (same table); Scion_Players_Guide__Saints__Monsters_(Final_Download).pdf p. 87 (Boon / Sorcerer band)
_meta.note: Costs are per purchase (one dot, one Knack, etc.). Prerequisites from the books still apply at the table.

attribute.change: Add one dot to a single Attribute

birthright.change: Add one dot in a new or existing Birthright

skill.change: Add one dot in a new or existing Skill

specialty.change: Add a Specialty to a Skill

boon.change: Add a new Boon (Saints & Monsters heroic band)

technique.change: Learn an additional Technique beyond natural Working gains
